stem:
Inesh learns that wind and rain slowly break a rock into smaller pieces of the same rock material. No new substance forms.

Which claim correctly classifies this change?

options.text: It is a physical change, because the rock is broken into smaller pieces of the same material.
It is a chemical change, because breaking a rock always produces a new substance.
It is a chemical change, because wind and rain are natural forces.
It cannot be classified, because slow natural changes have no type.

teacher.key_rationale: Same material in smaller pieces with no new substance is a physical change. Breaking does not by itself create a new substance here.
